schema: CREATE TABLE "readings" ("id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "batch_id" INTEGER, "amount" REAL, "sensor_x" INTEGER, "sensor_y" INTEGER);
correct_query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM readings WHERE batch_id IN (SELECT batch_id FROM readings GROUP BY batch_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AND (sensor_x, sensor_y) IN (SELECT sensor_x, sensor_y FROM readings GROUP BY sensor_x, sensor_y HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant omits ROUND(..., 2) on SUM(amount) and rewrites grouped IN subqueries as correlated COUNT(*) subqueries
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM readings AS r1 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM readings AS r2 WHERE r1.sensor_x = r2.sensor_x AND r1.sensor_y = r2.sensor_y) = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM readings AS r3 WHERE r1.batch_id = r3.batch_id) > 1
